title: Characterization of the bacterial colonization of the pancreatic main duct
summary:
This study aims to investigate whether there are bacteria in the main pancreatic duct that can directly attack tissue or activate enzymes which may lead to the breakdown of the newly created connection between the intestine and the pancreatic duct.
The goal is to provide evidence of bacterial colonization of the pancreatic duct and to understand its influence on the development of leakage at the new connection between the intestine and the pancreas.
conditions: Bacterial colonization of the pancreatic duct

interventions.name: Patients scheduled for elective open or minimal-invasive pancreaticoduodenectomy with a pancreaticojejunostomy

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients scheduled for elective open or minimal-invasive pancreaticoduodenectomy 
Written informed consent

Intraoperative inclusion criteria:
Reconstruction of pancreaticojejunostomy
Exclusion criteria:
Emergency surgery
American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) score > III
Participation in another intervention-trial with interference regarding intervention and outcome of this study
